references.text: The previous verse describes the hangings on one side of the gate opening with fifteen cubits of hanging, three pillars and three bases—a parallel structure to this verse which describes the other side.
The fulfillment of the instruction given here, where the other side of the courtyard gate was actually made with fifteen cubits of hanging, three pillars and three bases.
The broader context for the construction of the courtyard, providing the complete description of the hangings, pillars and bases around the entire tabernacle courtyard.
Similar construction with pillars and bases of copper for the entrance to the tabernacle tent, showing the consistent pattern in the tabernacle's architecture.
Documentation of fulfillment: 38:14 confirms that the instruction in 27:15 was carried out exactly as prescribed.
